parts.notes: 5 inch aero truss arms, deadcat camera path, 30.5 mm stack, HDZero 1W tray. Substitute AOS 5 V2 if EVO is unavailable. Do not upsize to 5.5: that frame wants ~1800 KV, which fights the high-KV brief.
Ultra-high KV for 6S 5 inch. Thermal limit is the constraint. Fallback: same motor 2150 KV if winding temp exceeds ~90 C after a 20 s speed run.
High-pitch 2-blade for pitch speed. Carry Gemfan 51466-3 as a handling set if the 2-blade is unstable in gusts.
Burst budget ~157 A at the printed 150C. Charge to 4.35 V/cell (LiHV) only for speed runs; 4.20 V for practice. Never a 4S 1300 in this airframe.
8S-tolerant input, MSP DisplayPort, enough UARTs for ELRS + HDZero + GPS.

parts.item: iFlight BLITZ E60 Pro / E80 60–80 A 4-in-1, AM32
parts.notes: Continuous headroom for 2550 KV on 6S. Bidirectional DShot300. 1000 uF 50 V low-ESR cap on the pack pads.

parts.item: HDZero 1W VTX + HDZero Nano V3 16:9 camera
parts.notes: Digital, one-way, ~14–20 ms glass-to-glass. 1 W because 70 m/s leaves a 25 mW bubble in seconds. Not DJI O4, not analog.

parts.item: TrueRC Singularity 5.8 GHz (or VAS Ion) on a rear TPU 45-degree mount
parts.notes: No pagoda in the freestream. Keep 5.8 away from the 2.4 ELRS element by >= 40 mm.
Required ground side for HDZero. RapidFIRE/analog modules are unused.
ELRS 3.5+ Gem-X: 2.4 GHz + 900 MHz simultaneously. Dual-band T-antennas in TPU along the rear arms, >80 mm separation.

parts.item: RadioMaster Nomad or Bandit with Gemini Xrossband firmware
parts.notes: Packet rate: 2.4 Gemini D500 / F1000 for close speed runs; X100/X150 Full Res when the course is a long straight.

parts.notes: Speed verification and GPS Rescue after a long straight. 9 g. Not for navigation while racing.
